name: Revenue Leakage Detector & AI Recovery Pipeline

parameters.content:
## Revenue Leakage Detector & AI Recovery Pipeline

### How it works

This scheduled workflow audits spreadsheet data for revenue leakage by comparing invoices, delivered work, payments, and prior follow-ups. It detects recovery opportunities, logs tasks, then uses an AI agent to draft recovery dispatch content. Depending on eligibility, it sends a client email or posts an internal Slack alert, and finishes by creating an audit summary.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Schedule Trigger cadence for how often the revenue audit should run.
- Set the Config node values, including spreadsheetId, timezone, gracePeriodDays, and draftThresholdDays.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and ensure the spreadsheet has the expected invoice, work delivered, payment, follow-up, and recovery-task sheets/columns.
- Connect Google Gemini credentials for the AI Recovery Agent and verify the selected model is available.
- Connect Gmail credentials for client email dispatch and Slack credentials/channel settings for internal alerts.

### Customization

Adjust the leakage detection code, limit size, grace-period thresholds, AI prompt construction, and the email/slack eligibility rules to match your billing policy and recovery workflow.

@[youtube](d74YKhD0P24)

## Schedule and configuration

Starts the workflow on a schedule and applies core runtime settings such as the target spreadsheet, timezone, grace period, and draft thresholds.

## Fetch source records

Reads the operational source data from Google Sheets, including invoices, delivered work, payments, and existing follow-up records.

## Detect recovery tasks

Analyzes the fetched records to identify revenue leakage and builds recovery tasks, then caps the number of tasks processed in the current run.

## Log and prepare prompts

Branches from the limited recovery tasks to both log task records back to Sheets and prepare AI dispatch prompts for follow-up actions.

## Generate AI recovery

Uses the AI Recovery Agent with the connected Google Gemini chat model to generate recovery messaging or recommended actions from the prepared prompts.

## Parse and decide

Parses the AI output into structured fields and checks whether the case is eligible for a direct customer email or should be handled internally.

## Dispatch and audit

Sends the chosen recovery communication path: either a Gmail client email or an internal Slack alert, then consolidates the outcome in an audit summary.

Never claim a payment has been received unless the data says so. Customer messages must be polite and factual. Internal messages should recommend verification before adjustment.

parameters.jsCode:
const items=$('Detect Revenue Leakage').all().map(x=>x.json);
return [{json:{auditTimestamp:new Date().toISOString(),totalFindingsProcessed:items.length,totalRevenueAtRisk:items.reduce((s,x)=>s+(Number(x.amount_at_risk)||0),0),status:'COMPLETED',note:'Gross finding exposure can overlap and is not guaranteed recoverable revenue.'}}];
